topic: The QR code was inspired by the board game Go (Masahiro Hara, Denso Wave, 1994)
taste: Human cast (Hara, a factory worker); objects have no faces. The on-screen code is a random pattern, not a real scannable code.

claims.claim: The QR code was announced in 1994 by Denso Wave; engineer Masahiro Hara led its development to track car parts.
Barcodes held too little information, so workers had to scan many of them.
Hara got the idea while playing Go at lunch: black and white stones on a grid can carry information.
Square position-detection patterns in three corners let a scanner find the code and read it fast from any angle.
Denso Wave kept the patent but chose not to enforce it, so anyone could use QR codes for free.

rejected: 'barcodes held only 20 characters' (not confirmed in sources found)
'built for Toyota' (Denso's own page frames it as general factory need)
'10 times faster' figure (left out to keep the script short)
